description: The Lifan CUB-ADV (LF125-26R) is a unique "crossover" motorcycle that bridges the gap between a traditional city underbone (cub) and a rugged adventure bike. Designed to handle both paved streets and light off-road trails, it features a 119.7cc single-cylinder, air-cooled, four-stroke engine that delivers approximately 6.0 kW (8 HP) of power and 8.5 N·m of torque. Its standout "ADV" styling is underscored by spoke wheels, a front disc brake, and an elevated stance, giving it a more aggressive look than a standard scooter. With a lightweight frame of just 105 kg and a 4-speed auto-clutch transmission, the LF125-26R is built for maneuverability and ease of use. Modern touches like an LCD digital meter and LED lighting complement its utility, while its impressive fuel economy—rated at roughly 1.6L/100km—makes it a practical choice for riders seeking a versatile, dual-purpose commuter.

The Yadea EPOC is a luxury electric scooter designed for city commuting, combining enhanced power, handling, and quality with a sleek, modern appearance. It boasts Yadea's unique Graphene Battery, which offers a lifespan three times longer than conventional batteries and allows for extended travel distances. The scooter is powered by a 72V 38Ah TTFAR Graphene Battery, designed and manufactured by Yadea, ensuring consistent quality and performance.With a peak power of 3200W, the Yadea EPOC can reach speeds of up to 74 km/h in Sports Mode and 60 km/h in TTFAR Long Range Mode. It offers a maximum torque of 150N·m and can handle inclines of up to 16°, making it suitable for various terrains.One of the key features of the Yadea EPOC is its TTFAR Energy Retrieving Controller, which allows the battery to recharge while riding. The system converts kinetic energy into electric energy during activities like sliding, downhill riding, and braking, effectively extending the scooter's range.The EPOC also boasts a comprehensive LED lighting system, designed to provide maximum visibility with low energy consumption. With a brightness of 30,000 cd and a visibility distance of 60 meters, the LED grille lighting ensures safe and clear navigation, especially at night.Practicality is another highlight of the Yadea EPOC. It offers 30 liters of storage space, ample pedal space, and a comfortable saddle, making it well-suited for daily commuting needs. The scooter also features a 7-inch HD digital dashboard that provides all necessary information at a glance.The Yadea EPOC introduces a mobile app with Bluetooth connectivity, enhancing user convenience. The app allows for features like unlocking the scooter and customizing settings. Once the scooter is paired with the user's app via a QR code, only the user can operate it, adding an extra layer of security.

The Yadea G6 2026 is a premium electric maxi-scooter designed for the urban commuter, notable for its sleek and elegant aesthetics which earned it a Red Dot Design Award. Powering the scooter is a TTFAR motor, often quoted with a rated power of 2000W and a peak power of 3000W, allowing for a top speed of around 60 km/h. Its range is a strong selling point, typically stated to be up to 100-150 km depending on the source and testing conditions, thanks to its high-capacity 72V 38Ah Graphene battery. The G6 also features modern touches like full LED lighting, a digital display, and smartphone connectivity for real-time status monitoring, alongside practical elements such as dual disc brakes, regenerative braking, and a generous under-seat storage capacity (around 30 liters). It is positioned as a comfortable and high-performance option in the electric scooter market, combining functionality with an eye-catching, futuristic design.

The newly released Honda HooRide 125 (globally recognized as the HRD 125) is an aggressive, adventure-style crossover scooter developed under the Wuyang-Honda joint venture. Breaking away from traditional, conservative commuter designs, the HRD 125 embraces a rugged, "mechanical aesthetic" inspired by the iconic Africa Twin dual-sport motorcycle, complete with a sharp front beak, twin-pod LED headlights, C-shaped DRLs, and a two-position adjustable windscreen. Beneath its tough exterior beats the highly efficient 124.7cc liquid-cooled eSP+ engine borrowed from the PCX 125, pumping out 11 horsepower and 11.7 Nm of torque while delivering an impressive claimed fuel efficiency of up to 47.17 km/L.What truly sets this mini-ADV scooter apart is its premium tech suite—features rarely seen in the 125cc segment—including a 5-inch TFT instrument cluster, dual-channel ABS, traction control, a tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS), and a dedicated handlebar mounting bar that can even sync up with DJI action cameras. Highly practical for daily grinds, it pairs a flat step-through floorboard with clever packaging; the 8.2-liter fuel tank is tucked inside the floor, freeing up enough underseat storage to fit two half-face helmets.

For safety, the front and rear disc brakes provide strong stopping power. The comfortable seat and good suspension make it a smooth ride, even on bumpy roads. The fuel tank is also big enough to allow long rides without needing frequent refueling.

The newly launched Bajaj Pulsar 220F 2026 has been updated with a key safety feature and fresh aesthetics to keep the iconic model relevant. The most significant mechanical update is the introduction of dual-channel Anti-lock Braking System (ABS), which was previously a single-channel unit. This enhancement drastically improves braking safety by preventing both the front and rear wheels from locking up under hard or panic braking. Cosmetically, the motorcycle gets new graphics and fresh color schemes, such as Black with Copper Beige accents and Green Light with Copper highlights, adding a contemporary touch to its signature semi-faired design. Powering the bike remains the familiar and reliable 220cc air and oil-cooled, single-cylinder engine, which produces approximately 20.11 bhp and 18.55 Nm of peak torque, paired with a 5-speed gearbox. It also retains modern features like a fully digital LCD instrument cluster with Bluetooth connectivity for turn-by-turn navigation and call/message alerts, reinforcing its value proposition as a powerful, feature-rich, and now safer sports commuter.

description: Honda has recently made a significant entry into the 150cc motorcycle segment with the official launch of the new Honda CG 150 2026, aiming to capture a market similar to how its CG 125 dominates its class. The newly launched CG 150 2026 offers a blend of traditional aesthetics and modern features, targeting riders who prioritize simplicity, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. description: The 2026 Yamaha FZ-S Fi Hybrid is a modern motorcycle that combines advanced technology with practical features. At its heart is a 149cc, single-cylinder, air-cooled engine producing 12.4 horsepower and 13.3 Nm of torque. This engine now complies with OBD-2B standards, ensuring better performance and lower emissions.One of the standout features is the hybrid system, which includes a Smart Motor Generator (SMG). This system provides battery-assisted acceleration, giving the bike a slight boost during quick maneuvers and making engine starts quieter. Additionally, the Stop and Start System (SSS) automatically turns off the engine when idling and restarts it when the clutch is engaged, helping to save fuel.The FZ-S Fi Hybrid also boasts a 4.2-inch color TFT display that connects to smartphones via Yamaha’s Y-Connect app. This feature offers turn-by-turn navigation linked to Google Maps and provides SMS and call alerts, enhancing the riding experience. In terms of design, the motorcycle features integrated front turn signals on the tank extensions, giving it a cohesive look. It is available in two color options: Racing Blue and Cyan Metallic Grey.For safety, the FZ-S Fi Hybrid comes equipped with a single-channel ABS and a switchable traction control system. The braking setup includes a 282 mm front disc and a 220 mm rear disc. Suspension duties are handled by a conventional telescopic front fork and a preload-adjustable rear monoshock. The motorcycle rides on 17-inch wheels, with 100-section front and 140-section rear tires, providing stability and grip.

description: The newly released Yadea Osta series positions itself as a premium neo-retro urban electric scooter lineup that blends classic styling with advanced digital and mechanical technology. Manufactured at Yadea's high-tech production facility, the 2026 Osta range consists of four distinct variants—the H, H+, P, and an upcoming Battery Swap model—all unified by a chic dual-tone design featuring a premium leather seat, full LED lighting, keyless entry, and a robust IPX7-rated waterproof wheel-hub motor producing a peak output of 2,750 W (3.7 hp) and 20 Nm of torque. While visually identical on the road, each model's internal specifications are tailored to different commuting needs. The entry-level Osta H pairs a 72V 30Ah LFP battery with a standard digital display and a front disc/rear drum brake setup, delivering a WMTC-certified range of 70 km and a top speed of 63 km/h. The Osta H+ upgrades to an intelligent TFT display with smartphone mirroring and replaces the rear drum brake with a disc unit, while offering a 120 km range and a top speed limited to 49 km/h. At the top of the lineup, the flagship Osta P enhances practicality with a larger 72V 45Ah battery, extending riding range to an impressive 180 km while retaining a top speed of 63 km/h. Across all variants, riders benefit from a comprehensive suite of electronic rider aids, including a Traction Control System (TCS), Hill Hold Control (HHC), and Push Assist, making the Osta series one of the most technologically advanced and well-rounded urban commuter platforms currently available.

The Yamaha EC-06 2026 is Yamaha’s newly released electric scooter aimed at urban commuters, blending practicality with modern technology. It is powered by a 4 kWh fixed lithium-ion battery paired with an efficient Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (IPMSM) that produces around 6.7 kW (9 hp) of peak power and 26 Nm of torque, giving it a top speed of about 79 km/h and a certified range of up to 169 km on a single charge—enough for most city riding needs. Charging from a standard home socket takes roughly eight hours, and Yamaha backs the battery with a 3-year/30,000 km warranty.In terms of features, the EC-06 sports full LED lighting, a colour LCD instrument cluster with connectivity via the Yamaha Motor Connect R app, and three selectable riding modes (Eco, Standard, Power) plus a handy reverse mode for easy manoeuvring in tight spaces. It also offers disc brakes front and rear with a Combi Brake System (CBS), conventional suspension suited for urban roads, and a 24.5 litre under-seat storage compartment for everyday essentials. The scooter’s clean, contemporary design and tech-friendly features make it a compelling choice in the growing e-scooter segment.

description: The Honda NX200 for 2026 has been officially launched, replacing the CB200X in Honda's lineup. This adventure motorcycle carries a similar design language to its predecessor but comes with a host of updates. It features a semi-faired design with a sharp LED headlamp, an upright windscreen, and knuckle guards, giving it a sporty and imposing stance. The NX200 is powered by an OBD2B-compliant 184.4cc, single-cylinder engine, delivering 16.7 BHP at 8,500 rpm and 15.7 Nm at 6,000 rpm, paired with a 5-speed gearbox via an Assist & Slipper Clutch.The bike rides on 17-inch alloy wheels with disc brakes at both ends and dual-channel ABS for safety. This motor uses special technology to make rides smooth and quick, so you don't feel any weak starts or sudden jerks.The scooter comes with two 72-volt, 27-ampere-hour (Ah) ATL lithium batteries. These batteries store a lot of energy without adding extra weight. They also have a smart system that charges them while you ride, which means you can travel up to 151 kilometers on a single charge, as tested under WMTC conditions at a maximum speed of 50 km/h.For a comfortable ride, the VoltGuard 2026 has front and rear hydraulic shock absorbers that help smooth out bumps in the road. It also features a combination braking system (CBS) that makes stopping safe and quick. The scooter has a 16-inch front tire and a 14-inch rear tire, which help you navigate through busy city streets easily.The seat is 700 millimeters long, providing enough space for you and a passenger, and the scooter can carry up to 150 kilograms. There's also plenty of storage: a 20-liter compartment under the seat and a 287-millimeter space on the floorboard for your belongings.In terms of technology, the VoltGuard 2026 includes features like multiple unlock options, NFC capabilities, and a reverse mode. These additions make it a convenient choice for daily commuting.

description: The 2026 Vespa S 125 arrives with classic Vespa charm plus subtle updates: it keeps the iconic steel monocoque body and flowing curves of the S-series but adopts new details like a trapezoidal LED headlamp (replacing the old oval lamp) for a sportier look, along with fresh color schemes (including matte dual-tones and a special Oro gold edition) and updated graphics that give it a more modern, premium feel. The cockpit largely stays retro, with an analogue speedometer and fuel gauge flanking a small digital display, but top Tech trims add a 5-inch full-color TFT dashboard (with Bluetooth and turn-by-turn navigation), keyless ignition and a USB charging port for smart connectivity. Comfort is enhanced by a newly shaped, more cushioned seat (with an ergonomic step-up design), a flat floorboard with a recessed footwell, and conveniences like a spacious under-seat trunk (big enough for a half-face helmet) plus a front bag-hook. Under the skin, the S 125 uses a refined 124.45cc single-cylinder 3-valve SOHC engine (air-cooled, fuel-injected) tuned to about 9.3–9.5 bhp at 7,100 rpm and 10.1 Nm of torque (a slight bump over the old model). Mated to a CVT, this delivers smooth city acceleration (about 0–60 km/h in ~8.6 seconds) and a top speed in the mid-80s km/h range, with fuel economy claimed around 45 km/L. The suspension is Vespa’s aircraft-inspired single-sided front fork (with anti-dive geometry) and a four-stage adjustable rear shock, giving a balanced, comfortable ride; safety gear includes a 200mm front disc brake (with a Combined Braking System) and a 140mm rear drum, while bright LED lighting front and rear improves visibility.

The scooter is equipped with a Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT), ensuring smooth and effortless acceleration.In terms of dimensions, the V125 measures 1,900 mm in length, 690 mm in width, and 1,130 mm in height, with a wheelbase of 1,330 mm. The seat height is set at 770 mm, providing a comfortable riding position for a variety of riders. The scooter has a fuel tank capacity of 6.5 liters, allowing for extended journeys without frequent refueling.The V125 2026 features a robust braking system with hydraulic disc brakes on both the front and rear wheels, each measuring 220 mm in diameter. This setup is complemented by a Combi Brake System (CBS), which distributes braking force evenly for enhanced safety. The scooter rides on 12-inch alloy wheels fitted with tubeless tires, sized 110/70-12 at the front and 120/70-12 at the rear, offering stability and grip on various road surfaces.The suspension system comprises telescopic forks at the front and a single suspension at the rear, designed to absorb road imperfections and provide a smooth ride. The V125's frame is constructed from high-quality steel, featuring a double-layer side panel and a central steel beam for added rigidity and durability. This semi-monocoque design not only ensures structural integrity but also allows easy access to the engine for maintenance.Aesthetically, the V125 pays homage to Lambretta's rich heritage with its classic lines and attention to detail. The scooter is equipped with a full LED lighting system, including headlights and taillights that incorporate the iconic Lambretta logo, enhancing visibility and adding a touch of elegance. The exhaust system is designed with sharp lines and includes heat shields, meeting EURO emission standards and reflecting Lambretta's commitment to environmental responsibility.

The Q2 features a robust suspension system with a telescopic front fork and a swingarm rear, offering substantial travel to absorb bumps and jumps effectively. It's equipped with hydraulic disc brakes for reliable stopping power in diverse conditions. The bike's battery provides a decent range, allowing riders to enjoy extended off-road adventures before needing a recharge. The Q2's design emphasizes rider comfort and ergonomics, ensuring a pleasurable experience even during long rides. Its knobby tires provide excellent grip on loose surfaces, further enhancing its off-road capabilities.

description: The Royal Enfield Bear 650 2026 is a motorcycle that pays homage to the scramblers of the 1960s, drawing inspiration from Eddie Mulder's victory at the 1960 Big Bear Run on a Royal Enfield. Built on the brand's popular 650cc parallel-twin platform, the Bear 650 distinguishes itself with a scrambler-specific design and upgraded components. It features a strengthened double-cradle frame, an all-new subframe, and a higher seat height of 830mm compared to its siblings. The bike's styling is characterized by its kicked-up rear loop, a scrambler-style bench seat, and chunky, dual-purpose MRF Nylorex tires on a 19-inch front and 17-inch rear spoked wheel setup.Powering the Bear 650 is the familiar 648cc air/oil-cooled parallel-twin engine, which has been retuned to deliver an 8% increase in peak torque, now at 56.5 Nm at 5,150 rpm, while maintaining a peak power output of 47 bhp. This is achieved with a new 2-into-1 exhaust system that also reduces weight and mass. The bike's suspension is upgraded to a Showa-sourced setup, with 43mm upside-down forks at the front and twin shocks at the rear, offering more travel than the Interceptor 650. For modern functionality, the Bear 650 is equipped with a full-color TFT Tripper Dash display with Bluetooth connectivity and Google Maps-powered navigation, as well as full LED lighting and switchable dual-channel ABS.

Underneath its vintage-inspired aesthetic, the V302C is powered by a unique 298cc liquid-cooled V-twin engine delivering roughly 29 hp and 26.5 Nm of torque.A standout feature remains its belt-drive system, a rarity in this displacement class that offers a quieter, smoother ride and reduced maintenance compared to traditional chains. Moving beyond the urban focus of its predecessor, the XQi3, the XQi 500 delivers a substantial boost in performance with a 28.8 kW (approximately 39 hp) peak output and a high-voltage 96V 40Ah battery system. Its design draws inspiration from sports cars, featuring iconic shapes and sculpted surfaces that give it a dynamic appearance.At the heart of the Fierider is an 11 kW side-mounted integrated motor that delivers a peak torque of 238 Nm. description: The 2026 Royal Enfield Guerrilla 450 is a modern roadster motorcycle that combines classic design with contemporary features. It is powered by a 452cc liquid-cooled, single-cylinder engine, producing 39.4 brake horsepower (bhp) at 8,000 revolutions per minute (rpm) and 40 Newton-meters (Nm) of torque at 5,500 rpm. This engine is paired with a six-speed gearbox and includes a slip-assist clutch for smoother gear shifts.The bike offers two riding modes: Performance and Eco. Performance mode provides a more responsive throttle for spirited riding, while Eco mode optimizes fuel efficiency for longer journeys. The Guerrilla 450 features a steel twin-spar frame, utilizing the engine as a stressed member to enhance rigidity and handling. Its suspension system includes 43mm telescopic front forks with 140mm travel and a rear monoshock with 150mm travel, ensuring a comfortable ride over various terrains.Braking is managed by a 310mm ventilated disc at the front and a 270mm disc at the rear, both equipped with dual-channel ABS for improved safety. The motorcycle rides on 17-inch wheels fitted with tubeless tires—120/70 at the front and 160/60 at the rear—providing stability and grip.The Guerrilla 450 is available in three variants: Analogue, Dash, and Flash. The Analogue variant features a semi-digital instrument cluster, while the Dash and Flash variants come with a 4-inch TFT display offering smartphone connectivity, navigation, and music controls. All variants include LED lighting, with a retro-styled round headlamp and integrated LED tail light and indicators.With a seat height of 780mm and a kerb weight of 185kg, the Guerrilla 450 is accessible to a wide range of riders. Its 11-liter fuel tank supports extended rides without frequent refueling.

description: The Honda NX400 2026 is a versatile adventure motorcycle designed for both city streets and off-road trails. It features a 399cc liquid-cooled, parallel-twin engine that delivers 45.4 horsepower and 38 Nm of torque, providing smooth acceleration and reliable performance. The 19-inch front and 17-inch rear wheels, fitted with dual-purpose tires, enhance grip and control on both paved roads and dirt paths.Technologically, the NX400 is equipped with a 5-inch full-color TFT display that shows essential ride information clearly. Safety features include the Honda Selectable Torque Control (HSTC) system, which helps maintain traction on slippery surfaces, and a dual-channel ABS that ensures effective braking performance.The bike's design combines toughness with a modern aesthetic. It has a high-mounted fairing for wind protection and a compact LED lighting system that enhances visibility. With a 17-liter fuel tank, the NX400 is well-suited for long-distance journeys, offering riders the freedom to explore without frequent refueling stops.

description: The Husqvarna Svartpilen 401 2026 is a modern motorcycle designed for city adventures. Its name, meaning "Black Arrow," reflects its sleek and minimalist design. description: The newly launched Triumph Thruxton 400 2026 is the latest addition to Triumph's growing 400cc lineup, a retro-inspired cafe racer that brings classic style and modern performance to a new segment. Built on the same platform as its siblings, the Speed 400 and Scrambler 400 X, the Thruxton 400 stands out with its dedicated cafe racer aesthetics. This includes a distinctive half-fairing with a retro-styled round LED headlamp, low-set clip-on handlebars, bar-end mirrors, and a sporty rear-seat cowl, which is often detachable. Powering the bike is a re-tuned version of the familiar 398cc, single-cylinder, liquid-cooled engine, which now produces a slightly bumped-up 41.4 bhp. Triumph claims this retuning provides a sportier character with a more rev-happy nature and better top-end performance, making it quicker off the line compared to the Speed 400. The Thruxton 400 is also equipped with modern features such as a semi-digital instrument cluster, dual-channel ABS, and traction control. It's designed for riders who appreciate a committed riding stance and classic British motorcycling heritage, offering a unique and aggressive look that pays homage to its larger Thruxton 1200 sibling. Positioned as a premium offering in the 400cc segment, the Thruxton 400 carves out a niche for itself, blending timeless design with contemporary technology and performance.

description: The Triumph TF 450-E 2026 is a high-performance enduro motorcycle engineered for riders seeking power, agility, and advanced technology. At its core lies a 449.9cc single-cylinder, four-stroke, SOHC engine that delivers 58.6 PS of maximum power and 49.3 Nm of peak torque. This engine features a 95 mm bore and stroke, with a compression ratio of 12.8:1. Fuel delivery is managed by a Dell'Orto 44 mm throttle body, ensuring precise and responsive throttle control. The powerplant is mated to a six-speed gearbox equipped with an Exedy racing clutch, facilitating smooth, clutch-less upshifts crucial for maintaining momentum in technical sections.To enhance durability and reduce friction, the TF 450-E's engine incorporates Del West titanium valves and a forged Konig aluminum piston. Additionally, the gudgeon pin and rockers are treated with Diamond Like Carbon (DLC) coatings. Cooling is efficiently managed by a high-capacity radiator complemented by an auxiliary fan, ensuring consistent engine performance during demanding rides. The air filtration system features a tool-free, dual-stage filter provided by Twin-Air, simplifying maintenance.Triumph has collaborated with Athena to develop a bespoke engine management system for the TF 450-E, featuring co-developed mapping and traction control strategies tailored to enhance performance and reliability. Riders can switch between two distinct engine maps on the fly: one for aggressive performance and another for smoother, more controlled delivery on technical terrain. Additional maps can be added using the optional Wi-Fi module and the Triumph MX Tune Pro app.The chassis features a lightweight aluminum spine frame, designed to provide an optimal balance of stiffness, low center of gravity, and agility. This design ensures high-speed stability and sharp directional control, instilling rider confidence. The frame's construction includes post-fabrication machining for enhanced dimensional accuracy and in-house hand TIG-welded craftsmanship.Suspension duties are handled by fully adjustable KYB components, with 48 mm coil-sprung forks offering compression and rebound adjustments, and a three-way adjustable linkage-driven rear shock. The suspension is specifically tuned for enduro challenges, providing responsive control, excellent power transfer, and maximum traction in demanding conditions. The setup offers an outstanding balance between handling and bump absorption, while minimizing pitch during cornering. Braking components include Brembo calipers paired with Galfer discs, featuring a 260 mm front disc and a 220 mm rear disc, ensuring precise and responsive braking performance. The TF 450-E rides on D.I.D DirtStar rims, with a 21” x 1.6” front wheel and an 18” x 2.15” rear wheel, fitted with Michelin Enduro 2 tires for superior traction and control across various terrains.

description: The 2026 BMW R 1300 RS is powered by a brand-new 1,300 cc air/liquid-cooled boxer twin, known as BMW ShiftCam, that delivers 107 kW (145 hp) at 7,750 rpm and 149 Nm torque at 6,500 rpm. By increasing the bore to 106.5 mm and decreasing the stroke to 73 mm, BMW has boosted output over the outgoing R 1250 RS, which made 100 kW/136 hp and 143 Nm, resulting in the most powerful production BMW boxer engine to date in terms of horsepower. A counterbalancer shaft and modern engine management smooth out vibrations and improve throttle response. Power is sent through a 6-speed gearbox and shaft drive, with an optional Automated Shift Assistant (ASA) offering clutchless upshifts and downshifts. The RS comes equipped with three standard ride modes: Rain, Road, and Eco, with Eco tuned for maximum range, and offers two extra modes, Dynamic and Dynamic Pro, in the Riding Modes Pro package. Traction control (DTC) and Engine Drag Torque Control (MSR) are standard to prevent rear-wheel lift under heavy braking. The fuel capacity is a generous 17 liters, approximately 4.5 gallons, up from about 15 liters on the old model, giving excellent range for touring. The R 1300 RS rides on an all-new chassis with a sheet-steel main frame and die-cast aluminum rear subframe, which is stiffer and more compact than the old tubular frame, allowing BMW to concentrate mass lower and toward the center. The bike has a nearly 54/46% rearward weight bias and a curb weight of approximately 272 kg, with a dry weight of 245 kg. Lighter 17-inch cast-alloy wheels with a hollow-spoke design shave over 1.4 kg off the unsprung weight of the previous RS, improving agility and suspension response. Up front is a new 47 mm inverted fork, and at the rear is an evolved single-sided Paralever swingarm. Electronic Dynamic ESA suspension with automatic damping adjustment is standard, and an optional Dynamic Suspension Adjustment (DSA) package adds automatic spring preload and damping changes tied to riding mode, a BMW first on a telescopic fork. Braking is handled by dual 310 mm floating front discs with four-piston radial calipers and a 285 mm rear disc with a two-piston caliper. BMW’s fully linked ABS Pro is standard, and an optional Sport Brake package with titanium-colored Brembo calipers gives slightly more bite. The new RS features a slim full-LED headlight with separate low/high-beam projectors and distinctive daytime running lights, and for the first time on an RS model, BMW offers the optional adaptive Headlight Pro system with additional LED elements that rotate to light up around corners based on lean angle. The cockpit centers on a 6.5-inch full-color TFT display controlled by a handlebar thumbwheel, and standard comfort and safety kit includes Dynamic Cruise Control with brake-enabled functionality and Bluetooth/USB-C connectivity. The optional Riding Assistant package adds radar-based active cruise control, Front Collision Warning, Lane Change Warning with blind-spot assist, and Rear-End Collision Warning. Despite its sporty intent, the R 1300 RS offers many touring comforts, including a standard rider’s seat height of 790 mm with an option to raise it to 815 mm, and BMW offers four accessory seats, including heated and lower sport versions. The tinted windscreen is two-tone and electrically height-adjustable, and a plush two-person seat and optional passenger grab rails or pillion backrest improve two-up comfort. For luggage, BMW has developed an all-new electrified case system. The new R 1300 RS introduces several BMW-first features, including the optional Dynamic Suspension Adjustment system and the adaptive Headlight Pro, giving the bike a sharper look and better aerodynamics, which boosts the claimed top speed to about 149 mph.

description: The Can-Am Maverick R 2026 continues its legacy as a top-tier performance side-by-side, offering a range of variants tailored for different off-road disciplines. At its core, the Maverick R lineup is powered by a turbocharged 999cc Rotax ACE triple-cylinder engine, delivering an impressive 240 horsepower. This power is managed by a recalibrated dual-clutch transmission (DCT) for smoother, sharper acceleration. A key feature across the lineup is the advanced suspension, which includes a forged aluminum heavy-duty Tall Knuckle and a 4-Link Trailing arm setup, providing exceptional travel (24-25 inches) and durability. The 2026 models also boast a new 10.25-inch touchscreen display with integrated GPS and other connected features, enhancing the in-cab experience.The Maverick R comes in several specialized variants, each with its own unique characteristics. The Maverick R X and its four-seat counterpart, the Maverick R MAX X, serve as the base models, equipped with FOX 2.5 PODIUM Piggyback shocks and a Smart-Lok front differential. For those seeking even higher performance, the Maverick R X rs and Maverick R MAX X rs add premium features like FOX 3.0 PODIUM RC2 shocks with bypass, and the option for Can-Am's Gen 3 Smart-Shox semi-active suspension. A new addition to the 2026 lineup is the Maverick R X rc, specifically engineered for rock crawling. This variant features a low-gear transmission, a specialized ROCK mode on the Smart-Lok differential, and massive 35-inch XPS Hammer King tires, along with a steering damper and reinforced protection. This diverse lineup ensures that whether a rider is tackling dunes, trails, or technical rock sections, there's a Maverick R built to conquer the challenge.
